sections.title: Who we are
body: SoTreina is a personal training tracker (running, strength training and diet), operated independently. It is not developed, sponsored or endorsed by Strava.
For anything related to your data, write to contas@sotreina.com.

sections.title: Data we collect
body: Account: email and password (stored only as a hash) when you sign up with email; name and profile picture when you sign in with Strava.

Strava data, only if you connect your account: running activities (date, distance, time, pace, elevation, heart rate, cadence, summary route and laps), gear (shoes), best efforts and heart rate zones.
Data you enter in SoTreina itself: strength workouts, foods eaten, meals and goals.

sections.title: How we use your data
body: Your data is used only to show you your own workouts, statistics and charts. None of your data is shown to other users.
We don't sell or share your data with third parties for advertising, and we don't use Strava data to train or feed artificial intelligence systems.
Strava access is read-only: SoTreina never posts anything to your profile.

sections.title: Where your data is stored
body: We use these providers to run the service: Render (server), Neon (database), Vercel (website), Resend (transactional emails such as password resets) and Cloudflare (DNS). They process data only on our behalf.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Data is kept while your account exists and Strava stays connected. When Strava access is revoked, all data that came from Strava is deleted.

sections.title: How to withdraw consent
body: You can disconnect Strava at any time under Profile → Disconnect, or revoke access directly on Strava at strava.com/settings/apps. Either way, all activities and other data that came from Strava are deleted from SoTreina.
If your account has no password (Strava sign-in only), disconnecting deletes the whole account, since there would be no way left to access it.

sections.title: How to request deletion
body: To delete your account and all your data (including strength training and diet), email contas@sotreina.com from your registered address. We confirm the deletion in writing.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Under the GDPR and Brazil's LGPD, you can request access to, correction, portability or deletion of your data, and object to its processing. Just write to contas@sotreina.com.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: If this policy changes, the date at the top of the page will be updated.

sections.title: Contact us
body: Questions, problems or suggestions: write to contas@sotreina.com. We reply within 3 business days.
If the problem is with a specific activity, include its date and, if possible, its Strava link.

sections.title: How do I connect my Strava account?
body: On the sign-in screen, tap "Connect with Strava" and authorize access on strava.com. If you already have a SoTreina account with email and password, connect from your Profile.
Access is read-only: SoTreina never posts anything to your Strava profile.

sections.title: My activities are not showing up
body: SoTreina syncs with Strava automatically every 6 hours. To fetch right away, use the Sync button in Run → Activities.
On the first connection, a long history can take a few minutes to import because of Strava API usage limits. The screen shows the progress.

sections.title: How do I disconnect Strava?
body: In Profile → Disconnect, or by revoking access at strava.com/settings/apps. Either way, all activities and other Strava data are deleted from SoTreina.
If your account has no password (Strava sign-in only), disconnecting deletes the whole account. To keep your strength training and diet data, add a password in your Profile first.

sections.title: I forgot my password
body: On the sign-in screen, tap "Forgot password" and enter your email. You will receive a link to set a new password, valid for 30 minutes.

sections.title: How do I delete my account?
body: Send an email to contas@sotreina.com from the address on your account. We delete the account and all your data and confirm in writing. See also the Privacy Policy at sotreina.com/privacidade.
